verdict.rationale:
Smithery ships a CLI (search/add/call tools) and a documented REST API with an OpenAPI 3.1 spec, service tokens scoped for AI agents/automation, and a live registry API queryable without interactive auth — all of which support scripted/headless use in CI pipelines. Runtime probes confirm the CLI installs and runs (`smithery --version`) and the API/registry endpoints respond programmatically.
missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples or GitHub Actions integration docs, and independent reports of real-world CI usage.
